title: Cross-Contract Security Review — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Cross-Contract Security Review solution should meet the objective: Write a threat model and review authorization, external calls, reverts, oracles, and privilege boundaries across a multi-contract local example. Rank findings and retest each fix. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
